about: Hand-labelled set for the hint check (lib/orchestrator/hint-check.ts): every rung 2–3 decision in the saved runs (deduped) plus 4 synthetic items for the cases the prompt names (data only, moved on, unrelated question, a plain narrowing). Labels follow the prompt's rung meanings. Labelled 8 Oct before any model saw them.
